approach.method_basis: The Parent is a task-local graph genetic algorithm whose evaluation budget is spent by a Gaussian-process Thompson sampler. It keeps every scored molecule of the current session in an archive and the best sixty-four in a breeding population, draws breeding parents from high-scoring score quantiles, and builds a fresh field of a hundred and sixty de novo offspring per announced batch of ten by connected-fragment crossover with an optional finishing edit or by a short random walk of atom, bond and ring edits, rejecting anything that is not a single ordinary connected graph, is already known, or introduces a sulfur local environment outside a fixed neutral envelope more often than its own scored parents did. It then fits a Gaussian process to the accepted scores of this session only, using integer-count radius-two Morgan fingerprints and a generalized Tanimoto kernel with the scores recentred and rescaled by their running mean and spread, and draws one correlated posterior sample per batch position over the whole field. The ten molecules it sends to the oracle are the sequential maxima of those draws: each position takes the best sampled value among the members still available, and the winner is removed before the next position. Every candidate in the field competes at every position, so a member the model scores poorly on average can still win a position when its sampled residual is large. Nothing in the Parent reacts to whether the search is making progress.
approach.novelty: This node makes the eligible choice set, rather than the sampling law or the amount of breeding, respond to stagnation. It keeps one counter of consecutive announced batches that did not raise the session's own best score, and while that counter stands at three or more it offers the sampler only the forty members of the unchanged hundred-and-sixty-member field that the fitted model ranks highest by posterior mean; the other hundred and twenty are simply not available for that batch. The first improving batch restores the full field. Everything the sampler then does is inherited untouched: the same pool, the same random draws in the same order and the same count of them, the same covariance factor, the same residual scale, the same removal of each winner before the next position and the same first-index tie rule. This is a pure restriction of candidate eligibility, which is the one thing the lineage has never varied. Siblings on this Parent either changed how many candidates were bred for the sampler to see (fourfold wider, fourfold narrower, and wider only during stalls), changed the sampler's randomness (wider residuals during stalls), or removed parts of the model and the selector altogether; none of them changed which members of a field of fixed size the sampler was permitted to pick while the search was stuck. Because the restriction keeps a field four times the announced batch, it also sits deliberately between the inherited full lottery and the pure greedy rule that this lineage has already measured as much worse.

observed_bottleneck: The Parent Anchor n-1744a1494180 does not convert measurably unproductive batches into endpoint gain, and its own receipts locate the waste in which candidates the allocator is allowed to pick while the search is stuck. Its complete fifteen-cell panel is macro mean 0.596453 with population SD 0.033970 and only +0.000783 over its own Parent n-62daf219c70a, so the registered +0.002 matched-gain criterion is unmet. Recomputing the registered K=3 counter read-only from the Parent's own published trajectories and task logs (runs/SPIRAL2/nodes/n-1744a1494180/seed-0|1|2/trajectories/<task>.jsonl and seed-0|1|2/logs/<task>.log, 29 announced batches per session) reproduces the exposure the round-38 siblings reported: 91 of 435 announced batches in 29 episodes across 13 of 15 sessions, with deco_hop seeds 0 and 2 never reaching the threshold. adoptions.borrowed_element: The failure-counter-conditioned sharpening response: after a run of consecutive batches that produce no new best observation, restrict the region that Thompson-sampled candidates may be selected from, so the allocation concentrates near the incumbent instead of spreading over the whole space, and restore the previous behaviour on a success.

deviations.adopted_setting: A rank restriction of the eligible candidate set to the top forty of one hundred and sixty by fitted posterior mean, applied in stalled batches only, with no geometric region, no halving or doubling and no size bounds.
deviations.paper_setting: A trust region is a hyperrectangle in a continuous coordinate space whose side length L is halved on failure and doubled on success, bounded by L_min and L_max.
deviations.reason: A freshly bred molecular graph pool has no coordinate box to shrink. The campaign's own evidence says what to sharpen instead: on this Anchor the in-regime incumbent-beating offspring come from the top of the posterior mean and none from the top posterior-SD decile, so model value is the available notion of locality and a single bound restriction is the testable form of it.

deviations.adopted_setting: One integer counter of consecutive non-improving announced batches with K = 3, defined on this session's own best-so-far at announcement, reset only by an improving batch and bound identically to the four round-38 siblings.
deviations.paper_setting: The counter is tau_fail consecutive failures with TuRBO-1 defaults tau_succ = 3 and tau_fail = ceil(d/q), and both counters are reset whenever the region size changes.
deviations.reason: The trigger must stay identical to the already measured round-38 trigger so this position's contrast isolates the eligible set rather than a new trigger, and ceil(d/q) has no meaning without a coordinate dimension. literature_review.conclusion: The ticket's frozen basis supplies the element to adopt and this review read its full text to fix the exact rule: a consecutive-failure counter whose success is a new best observation, and a sharpening response that restricts where Thompson-sampled candidates may come from, with the Sobol construction, coordinate-sparse perturbation, region doubling and the restart rule refused. Because a bred molecular pool has no coordinate box, the two additional sources searched here settle the two open questions that adaptation raises: CASMOPOLITAN shows counter-driven localization is well defined in a discrete space through a neighbourhood of the incumbent rather than a box, and epsilon-TS shows that deliberately reducing Thompson exploration while keeping the posterior update can beat full posterior sampling. Neither supplies a parameter: the paper's defaults are dimension-based and this campaign's own measurements bound the design instead, with pure mean-only allocation costing 0.116317 and composite selector removal 0.128183 on this exact Parent, which is why the eligible set is restricted to forty of one hundred and sixty rather than to the announced batch size. The literature therefore justifies the direction and the shape of the intervention, while the decision to test candidate eligibility rather than sampling amplitude rests on internal evidence: in this Anchor's own stalled stream 96.4% of positive original-parent gain mass and 27 of 28 incumbent improvements sit in the top forty posterior means, 218 of 910 in-regime oracle calls go outside it, and the opposite direction was refuted on identical pools. Literature origin is not permission to continue: one complete exposed panel ends this recipe, and if the masks apply exactly while in-regime realized increments do not rise, the candidate-set hypothesis is recorded as refuted for this Anchor with no M sweep.

finding_summary.headline: Stall-time top-forty eligibility ran exactly, raised in-regime realized gain, and the panel rose +0.0106 on all three seeds
finding_summary.insights:
The campaign now has a clean, exactly-audited answer to the question it asked: on this Anchor the low-mean tail of a stalled candidate field is not where the stalled budget has to be spent. Removing the bottom three quarters of the posterior-mean ordering during stalls cost nothing measurable inside the regime and raised every realized in-regime magnitude, while the same-state exchange at the first restricted batch shows directly what was traded: molecules averaging 0.31 for molecules averaging 0.43, six tiny fragments removed, one genuine incumbent improvement sacrificed for four new ones. That is the mirror image of the round-38 arm that widened stalled sampling toward uncertainty and was refuted on these same pools, and it is the first evidence on this Parent that candidate eligibility - not candidate supply, not model content, not the sampling law - is a live control surface during stalls.

What the result does not establish is that the panel gain is the mechanism's. Every endpoint difference arises after divergence in a single adaptive realization, and this round's neutral path reference, which changes no law at the same trigger, moved the panel -0.0017 while swinging single cells from -0.034 to +0.041, including +0.041 on a sitagliptin cell. The +0.0106 here lies outside that reference, and unlike the reference it is positive on all three seeds, which is the strongest discriminator available; but it rests on two sitagliptin cells, and sitagliptin is precisely where pure re-drawing was already shown to swing by that much. The honest reading is that activation and direct behaviour are established, in-regime benefit is established on the registered magnitudes, and endpoint attribution is not identified by one panel.

The run also exposes the cost of refusing the source method's release rule. The restriction has no expansion and no restart: it simply holds until a batch improves. In the three cells with a long restricted episode - zaleplon seed 1 restricted from batch 13 to the end of budget (17 consecutive batches, more than half the session's evaluations), zaleplon seed 0 for 8 and drd2 seed 2 for 9 - all three lost ground (-0.0353, -0.0359, -0.0083), while every gaining cell kept its longest restricted episode at five batches or fewer. Thirteen cells and one realization cannot make that causal, but it is the one structured pattern in the cell signs, and it points at a specific, testable next step that is not an M sweep: a release or escalation rule for long stalls, which is exactly the TuRBO element this adaptation declined. It also sharpens the known boundary - holding the eligible set at the top quarter for seventeen straight batches is the regime that approaches the already measured mean-only allocation, which costs 0.116 on this Parent.

Two further things are now narrowed. First, the registered channel judgment survived its own trap: this is not a favourable composition proxy with flat realized gain, which the campaign had recorded as a refutation pattern - the composition moved and the realized increments moved with it. Second, the chemistry says why single cells can decide a panel. The molecular review of this node finds late progress dominated by halogen and substituent permutations on one scaffold per objective, with questionable groups - N-halogen bonds in 888 of 4,350 proposals, nitroso and aminal centres, unassigned stereocentres - all of which the Parent shows too, so the restriction changed which permutation was reached, not the quality of chemistry the lineage proposes. In sitagliptin seed 2 the two paths even reached different molecules at exactly the same score 0.6201223, a plateau that makes a cell's endpoint partly a lottery over equivalent decorations. Still open: whether the gain survives a second realization, whether a release rule removes the long-stall losses, and whether this channel can be read jointly with the stall-only pool-breadth gain rather than summed with it.
finding_summary.results:
The restriction executed exactly as registered in all three seeds. Of the 435 announced batches, 88 were announced with the non-improving counter at three or more and were restricted; the other 347 kept the inherited full field. Across those 88 batches and their 880 selection positions the available count ran exactly 40, 39, ..., 31, the set available at the first position was exactly the top forty of the posterior-mean ordering recomputed from the logged means, and no available index ever lay outside it. Outside the regime the counts ran 160, ..., 151 with nothing excluded at any of 3,470 positions. The logged stall counter matched an independent recount from the run's own scored molecules in all 435 batches, every pool held 160 candidates against a target of 160, none was cut short, no batch fell back to the numerical route, and all fifteen cells spent their full 300 evaluations with no invalid or duplicate proposal.

Exposure landed almost exactly on the forecast from the Parent's own runs: 88 restricted batches in 29 stall episodes across the same 13 of 15 sessions, against the Parent's 91 in 29. Every session was the Parent's run, molecule for molecule, up to its own first restricted batch, and the first restricted batch fell on the same batch number as the Parent's in all 13 exposed sessions. The two deco_hop sessions on seeds 0 and 2 never reach the counter threshold and reproduced the Parent record for record, including the seed-0 endpoint of 0.856148 that no other Child of this Anchor has reproduced. The standard-normal rows were identical to the Parent's in all 435 batches, so the draw kept its shape, order and consumption count.

The eligible set moved where it was predicted to move. Not one of the 880 restricted oracle calls went to a candidate ranked 40 or worse by posterior mean, against 218 of 910 (23.96%) for the Parent; the mean rank of a restricted pick fell from 26.0 to 11.7 and the median from 14 to 8. Picks from the most uncertain tenth of the pool fell from 43 to 1, and the 22 one-to-four heavy-atom fragment picks of the Parent's stalled stream became zero. Outside the regime the distribution stayed at the Parent's level: 28.7% of picks ranked 40 or worse with a median rank of 15, against 27.3% and 15.

At each session's first restricted batch the state was identical to the Parent's - same pool molecules, same predicted means and uncertainties, same ten standard-normal rows, same scaling and the same matrix factorizations - so the exchange there is a clean same-state contrast, and it reproduced the preregistered replay forecast exactly: 46 of 130 picks changed, the molecules the restriction dropped realized 0.3055 on average against 0.3573 for the picks it kept, six of the dropped picks were tiny fragments and exactly one dropped pick was an incumbent improvement (median_2 seed 0, rank 58, score 0.1817). The molecules swapped in scored 0.4344 on average, and four of them were incumbent improvements. Over all 88 restricted batches the full-field rule replayed on the same draws would have taken 215 different molecules, of mean rank 79.8.

Inside the regime the realized magnitudes rose on every registered measure: summed best-so-far increments in restricted batches 0.547037 against 0.476561, positive gain over the generating parent 1.678700 against 1.643581, incumbent improvements 31 against 28, mean restricted-batch offspring score 0.412585 against 0.404629 and median 0.354215 against 0.346718. The rise is an aggregate, not a pattern: per-session restricted-batch increments were higher in 7 of 13 exposed sessions, lower in 5 and equal in 1, and the stall-breaking rate barely moved (25 of 88 batches, 28.4%, against 25 of 91, 27.5%). Gain attributable to restricted-batch offspring and their descendants rose from 0.935477 to 1.142388, and increments after the first stall from 1.039352 to 1.198010, so there is no sign of the later-batch loss that the sibling residual-contraction arm showed. Whole-run positive parent-gain mass fell slightly, 16.891241 against 17.251535, the same size of drift the round-39 neutral path reference produced with no rule change at all.

On the endpoint panel the complete matched fifteen cells rose from 0.596453 to 0.607030, a paired mean delta of +0.010577 that clears the registered +0.002 bar, with all three seed macros up (+0.006603, +0.022061, +0.003067) and the seed-macro population SD slightly tighter than the Parent's (0.0302 against 0.0340). The thirteen cells the gate can reach average +0.012204. The cell pattern is split: six cells up, six down, three exactly equal. By task the gain is sitagliptin_mpo (+0.0720 mean) with median_2 (+0.0061) and deco_hop (+0.0004) slightly up, against zaleplon_mpo (-0.0192) and drd2_docking (-0.0064). The margin is concentrated: dropping sitagliptin seed 1 (+0.1445) alone leaves +0.0010, and dropping both sitagliptin seed 1 and seed 0 (+0.0716) leaves -0.0038.

On the endpoint panel the complete matched fifteen cells rose from 0.596453 to 0.607030, a paired mean delta of +0.010577 that clears the registered +0.002 bar, with all three seed macros up (+0.006603, +0.022061, +0.003067) and the seed-macro population SD slightly tighter than the Parent's (0.0302 against 0.0340). The thirteen cells the gate can reach average +0.012204. The cell pattern is split: six cells up, six down, three exactly equal. By task the gain is sitagliptin_mpo (+0.0720 mean) with median_2 (+0.0061) and deco_hop (+0.0004) slightly up, against zaleplon_mpo (-0.0192) and drd2_docking (-0.0064). The margin is concentrated: dropping sitagliptin seed 1 (+0.1445) alone leaves +0.0010, and dropping both sitagliptin seed 1 and seed 0 (+0.0716) leaves -0.0038.

The campaign now has a clean, exactly-audited answer to the question it asked: on this Anchor the low-mean tail of a stalled candidate field is not where the stalled budget has to be spent. Removing the bottom three quarters of the posterior-mean ordering during stalls cost nothing measurable inside the regime and raised every realized in-regime magnitude, while the same-state exchange at the first restricted batch shows directly what was traded: molecules averaging 0.31 for molecules averaging 0.43, six tiny fragments removed, one genuine incumbent improvement sacrificed for four new ones. That is the mirror image of the round-38 arm that widened stalled sampling toward uncertainty and was refuted on these same pools, and it is the first evidence on this Parent that candidate eligibility - not candidate supply, not model content, not the sampling law - is a live control surface during stalls.

What the result does not establish is that the panel gain is the mechanism's. Every endpoint difference arises after divergence in a single adaptive realization, and this round's neutral path reference, which changes no law at the same trigger, moved the panel -0.0017 while swinging single cells from -0.034 to +0.041, including +0.041 on a sitagliptin cell. The +0.0106 here lies outside that reference, and unlike the reference it is positive on all three seeds, which is the strongest discriminator available; but it rests on two sitagliptin cells, and sitagliptin is precisely where pure re-drawing was already shown to swing by that much. The honest reading is that activation and direct behaviour are established, in-regime benefit is established on the registered magnitudes, and endpoint attribution is not identified by one panel.

The run also exposes the cost of refusing the source method's release rule. The restriction has no expansion and no restart: it simply holds until a batch improves. In the three cells with a long restricted episode - zaleplon seed 1 restricted from batch 13 to the end of budget (17 consecutive batches, more than half the session's evaluations), zaleplon seed 0 for 8 and drd2 seed 2 for 9 - all three lost ground (-0.0353, -0.0359, -0.0083), while every gaining cell kept its longest restricted episode at five batches or fewer. Thirteen cells and one realization cannot make that causal, but it is the one structured pattern in the cell signs, and it points at a specific, testable next step that is not an M sweep: a release or escalation rule for long stalls, which is exactly the TuRBO element this adaptation declined. It also sharpens the known boundary - holding the eligible set at the top quarter for seventeen straight batches is the regime that approaches the already measured mean-only allocation, which costs 0.116 on this Parent.

Two further things are now narrowed. First, the registered channel judgment survived its own trap: this is not a favourable composition proxy with flat realized gain, which the campaign had recorded as a refutation pattern - the composition moved and the realized increments moved with it. Second, the chemistry says why single cells can decide a panel. The molecular review of this node finds late progress dominated by halogen and substituent permutations on one scaffold per objective, with questionable groups - N-halogen bonds in 888 of 4,350 proposals, nitroso and aminal centres, unassigned stereocentres - all of which the Parent shows too, so the restriction changed which permutation was reached, not the quality of chemistry the lineage proposes. In sitagliptin seed 2 the two paths even reached different molecules at exactly the same score 0.6201223, a plateau that makes a cell's endpoint partly a lottery over equivalent decorations. Still open: whether the gain survives a second realization, whether a release rule removes the long-stall losses, and whether this channel can be read jointly with the stall-only pool-breadth gain rather than summed with it.

molecular.headline: Halogen-decorated fused heteroaromatics whose leaders carry N-halogen, nitroso and aminal groups; two of fifteen sessions are the Parent's molecules exactly
molecular.overall_character: Across the five objectives this node proposed 870 optimizer molecules per objective (4,350 in total: seeds 0, 1 and 2, 300 accepted observations each, of which ten are the shared initial records). Every one of the 4,350 parses as a valid neutral molecule; RDKit rejected none. They are medium-sized and heavily cyclic: mean 24.4-31.6 heavy atoms, MW 365-461, 3.03-4.81 rings and 2.08-3.48 aromatic rings per molecule, which agrees with the digest string counters (ring_closure_rate 0.971-0.986, aromatic_atom_rate 0.964-0.977, branch_rate 0.972-0.983). Elaboration is almost entirely peripheral decoration of a fused heteroaromatic or bridged polycyclic core with small groups: methyl, ethyl, propyl, methoxy, hydroxymethyl, acetyl, formyl and above all halogen (digest halogen_rate 0.81-0.99 on four objectives and 0.10 on the fifth). Halogen goes onto heteroatoms as readily as onto carbon: 888 of the 4,350 proposals contain an N-halogen bond and 162 an O-halogen bond, while exactly zero contain a trifluoromethyl group and only 16 any geminal difluoromethylene. No proposal carries a formal charge and none carries specified stereochemistry, matching the digest charged_rate 0.0 and stereocentre_rate 0.0 on all five objectives, yet RDKit finds unassigned stereocentres in 841 of 870 proposals on one objective (87 of 87 in its top-scoring decile) and in 324-632 on three others. 98 proposals have six or fewer heavy atoms and score at the objective floor. Full-set scaffold diversity is moderate (187-560 distinct Murcko scaffolds per 870) but each session's endgame is one family: the top-scoring decile spans only 12-42 scaffolds and a single scaffold holds 27 of 87, 26 of 87 and 38 of 87 on three objectives. Comparison is complete: context.comparison reports child_complete and paired_complete with seeds 0, 1, 2 matched against Parent n-1744a1494180, and all fifteen Child and fifteen Parent trajectory files named in the brief are present and readable. Thirteen of the fifteen sessions diverge from the Parent between evaluation 41 and evaluation 232; two sessions on one objective (seeds 0 and 2) are identical to the Parent for all 300 records, so the Child's own chemistry comes from thirteen sessions.

transferable_gaps.gap: The generator halogenates nitrogen and oxygen as freely as carbon and cannot build a polyhalogenated carbon substituent.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Halogen substitution is the cheapest edit the operator set has and it is applied without regard to the element it lands on. A task-agnostic generator would treat heteroatom-halogen bond formation as its own rarely valid class rather than one more substitution, and would supply the ordinary alternatives in its place: halogen on carbon, geminal polyhalogenation giving a stable CF3 or OCF3, or leaving the heteroatom as N-H or N-alkyl. Both directions matter, because a score surface that rewards halogen content is currently satisfied through the unstable placement, and a surface that rewards a stable lipophilic carbon substituent cannot be reached at all.

Every one of these parses and is valence-valid, so the failure is geometric, not syntactic.
transferable_gaps.gap: Ring-editing operators create transannular bonds inside aromatic rings, strained small rings and eight- to eleven-membered rings with no geometric feasibility test.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Ring formation, bridging and contraction are currently validated by valence and canonical identity alone. A task-agnostic generator would need ring-size and planarity awareness inside those operators: refuse a new bond between two atoms of the same aromatic ring, bound medium-ring closure to conformationally reachable cases, and offer an ordinary ortho-fused bicyclic as the alternative edit so that the topological complexity a score surface may reward is reached through feasible skeletons instead of strained ones.

transferable_gaps.evidence: The digest counters report charged_rate 0.0 and stereocentre_rate 0.0 on all five objectives over 870 proposals each, and structural perception of the same molecules finds unassigned stereocentres in 841 of 870 proposals on one objective and in all 87 of its top-scoring decile (CCc1cc(CCN2CCCNC2(F)c2cccc(Cl)c2)c(C)c(N)c1O, CCCc1c(Br)cc(Br)cc1CCN1CCCNC1(CC)c1cccc(Cl)c1), in 632 of 870 with 79 of the top 87 on a second (CCCc1cc(N2C3CC4=C(NCN4C(=O)CN(C)C3=O)C2CC)c2ccccc2n1), in 550 with 81 of the top 87 on a third and in 324 with 60 of the top 87 on a fourth. On the objective where a basic amine appears in 86 of the 87 top molecules, not one is written in a protonated or salt form.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator emits no charged species and no specified stereochemistry even where its own best molecules are stereogenic.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The representation as used cannot express configuration or protonation state, so every sp3 centre the operators build is an undefined mixture and any surface sensitive to enantiomers, diastereomers or ionisation is being scored on an ambiguous structure. A task-agnostic generator would assign configuration when it creates a stereogenic centre and carry it through crossover and mutation, or mark the centre explicitly as unresolved, and would be able to propose a charged or zwitterionic form where the neutral notation is not the physiologically relevant one.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Across the five objectives the proposals include nitroso groups in 240 of 870 molecules on one, with 49 of its top 87 nitroso-bearing (COCCc1c2c(c(C(N=O)Nc3cc4c(N=O)cc3-4)c(C)c1C(C)=O)N=C2), thiocarbonyls in 206 and peroxide O-O bonds in 78 of that same set, an alpha-chloro ether and a hypofluorite together on its best molecule (O=c1c2c3n(-c4ncnc5cc(OF)c(Cl)cc45)nc2n(c(=S)n1C(F)OCCl)C3) and an S-Br bond with two nitriles on another of its leaders (C=C(F)c1c(Oc2cccc(-c3ncc(C#N)c(Cl)c3Cl)c2)nc2oc(=O)nc(SBr)c2c1CC#N); aminal N-C-N centres in 229 of 870 on a second objective with 57 of its top 87 carrying a fully substituted one (CCC1(c2cccc(Cl)c2)NCCN1CCc1cc2c(c(Br)c1C)CC2), plus 153 primary or benzylic chlorides and a chlorohydrin on a 0.9963 molecule (CCc1c(Br)cc(C(O)Cl)cc1CCN1CCCNC1(CC)c1cccc(Cl)c1); an N-chloro alpha-ketoamide as the best molecule of a third (Cc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)C(=O)N(Cl)c3ccccc3)cc2c(C)c1C); sulfenamide N-SH groups in 80 proposals of a fourth (CN1C=C(c2c3c(=O)n(S)c(=N)n(F)c3cn2C2=CC(F)C=C2O)CC1F); and hydrazine-type N-N bonds in 122 proposals of a fifth (CCOc1cc(-n2nc3c(c2CC)CC(=O)N(C)C(=O)CN3C)c2ccccc2n1).
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no stability vocabulary and attaches reactive or short-lived groups to otherwise reasonable scaffolds.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Admission currently tests valence, canonical novelty and one narrow inherited sulfur rule, and nothing else about chemical stability. A task-agnostic generator would classify the local environment an edit creates against a general reactivity vocabulary covering N-O, O-halogen, N-halogen, N-S, N-N, peroxide, aminal, alkylating benzylic halide, alpha-halo ether and pseudohalide ester, and would then propose a conventional isostere that preserves the size, polarity and substitution pattern being rewarded instead of only rejecting the edit, since rejection alone would also remove the routes by which its current leaders were reached.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 98 of this node's 4,350 proposals have six or fewer heavy atoms, spread evenly over the five objectives (20, 25, 21, 12 and 20), and they arrive as late as evaluations 298, 299 and 300 of 300: CCCF at evaluation 298 on one objective, C=COC at 299 on another, and a bare C at 281 on a third. They include FF, FCl, C=COF, OS, N=O, ClCOCOCl, FOCS, CCOOCC, CCOOC, FC1CCN1 and SC12C=C(C1)O2, and every one of them lands at or near its objective's floor. The matched Parent n-1744a1494180 sessions show the same behaviour with 113 such proposals, so the capability gap is inherited rather than introduced.
transferable_gaps.gap: Deletion operators are unbounded below, so tiny fragments are proposed to the oracle instead of being repaired.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Atom, bond and ring deletion have no lower bound, so a measurable slice of every fixed evaluation budget is spent on molecules too small to carry any pharmacophore and on species no oracle can reward. A task-agnostic generator would bound deletion by a minimum heavy-atom count or by retention of at least one ring system and re-attempt the edit rather than emitting the fragment, which costs nothing in representation and returns those calls to candidates that can carry signal.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On one objective seven molecules tie at exactly 0.438799 and differ only in whether two positions carry F, Cl or Br and in which position the pyridyl nitrogen takes (CCc1c(OC)cc2c(c1C)c(Br)c(C(=O)Nc1ccccn1)n2F, CCc1c(OC)cc2c(c1C)c(F)c(C(=O)Nc1ccccn1)n2F, CCc1c(OC)cc2c(c1C)c(Cl)c(C(=O)Nc1ccccn1)n2F are three of them). Its top-scoring decile of 87 molecules spans 12 Murcko scaffolds with 27 sharing one, another objective's spans 12 with 26 sharing one and a third's spans 20 with 38 sharing one, against 187-560 distinct scaffolds in the full 870-molecule proposal sets. In the last fifty evaluations of a session the number of distinct scores falls as low as 38 of 50.
transferable_gaps.gap: Late-budget edits permute terminal heteroatom substituents, producing analogues that score identically.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The edit distribution concentrates on substituent identity at a few peripheral heteroatoms, the cheapest edit available and the one least likely to move any score. A task-agnostic generator would need edits that change the ring skeleton, the linker length and the fusion pattern at comparable frequency, and a way to recognise that a proposed analogue differs from an already-evaluated molecule only by a substitution class that has repeatedly returned the same score, so that late budget buys new chemistry rather than permutations of the incumbent.

transferable_gaps.evidence: All five objectives start from the same ten initial records, yet basic amine content in the 870 proposals ranges from 499 of 870 on one objective, where 86 of the 87 top-scoring molecules carry one, down to 20 of 870 on another where none of its top 87 does. Amide content ranges from 648 of 870 to 13 of 870. Sulfonamides and carboxylic acids survive only as early descendants of the one seed molecule that carried them, 76 and 51 proposals on a single objective, 47 and 32 of them in its lowest-scoring decile and none in its highest (O=C(NCl)C1CCCN1S(=O)(=O)c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1, COS(=O)(=O)c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1); on the four other objectives there are at most 4 acids and 1 sulfonyl group in 870 proposals. Where the generator does build a basic centre it reaches it through an aminal in 57 of 87 top molecules (CCC1(c2cccc(Cl)c2)NCCN1CCc1cc2c(c(Br)c1C)CC2) rather than through a plain saturated amine ring, and basic-amine content in one objective's top decile fell from 48 of 87 in Parent n-1744a1494180 to 20 of 87 here.
transferable_gaps.gap: Whole functional-group classes are reachable only by inheritance from the starting molecules, not by construction.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Entire polar and ionisable group classes are accessible only by inheritance, so a session that drifts away from a group early can never recover it even when it is the feature being rewarded, and the groups it can install arrive attached to labile carbons. A task-agnostic generator would need operators that install common polar and ionisable motifs as whole units, saturated amine ring, amide, sulfonamide and acid, onto whatever scaffold is current, instead of relying on single-atom edits to rediscover them.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
